input: Find tennis and pickleball camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville tennis pickleball junior summer camp 2026
tennis summer camps Brevard North Carolina juniors

candidates.name: Asheville Racquet Club
candidates.note: 2026 All Sports Camp for ages 5–14 included tennis, pickleball, other sports and swimming.

candidates.name: Hendersonville Racquet Club
candidates.note: 2026 youth tennis camps offered half/full days with pickleball and swimming; also high-performance camps for tournament players.

candidates.name: Asheville Tennis Association
candidates.note: Runs Terminettors summer tennis camp and junior clinics; July 2025 evening clinics also took place at Erwin High School.

candidates.name: Brevard Health & Racquet Club
candidates.note: Summer junior tennis instruction includes beginners, junior-high/high-school groups and a high-performance academy; page does not specify a year.
